clean_small_step_region.rule: camera depth 0.50-0.70 m and |camera x,y| <= 0.12 m
clean_small_step_region.interpretation: Forward is not consistently below 5 cm; the 1000 position weight did not establish a definitive improvement over the previous 800-weight run.

high_speed.interpretation: Model 2 is selected during high-speed forward motion. The final motor is well below 0.50, so this is not final-motor saturation. The force-rate bound is repeatedly active and is the more direct high-speed bottleneck.

high_speed_mixed_segment.interpretation: The pool/relative trajectory contains substantial lateral and vertical motion, so this interval is a high-speed mixed segment rather than a pure forward benchmark.

overhead_camera.status: monitor.mp4 was still open/incomplete at analysis time (no moov atom), so frame-level overhead-camera extraction was not possible without stopping the camera recorder
overhead_camera.online_use: The overhead view remained available to the operator; underwater relative trajectory was used for quantitative segmentation.

tuning_decision.recommendation: Test only forward delta_force_min/max from [-0.80, +0.80] N to [-1.00, +1.00] N; keep forward position weight at 1000 and keep all other weights, horizon, fusion, vision and firmware unchanged.
tuning_decision.reason: High-speed error remains large without final-motor saturation, while the first force increment is at its rate limit in about 65% of high-speed samples. Increasing the forward force-rate envelope is a more direct test than increasing position weight again.
tuning_decision.next_experiment: Use the overhead view to enforce a straight forward/back high-speed segment with |lateral| and |vertical| < 5 cm, depth 0.55-0.75 m, and compare braking delay, forward P95 error, first overshoot and motor peak. Abort if final motor approaches 0.45-0.50 or collision risk appears.
